translations.web: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of Yahweh is near, in the valley of decision.
translations.bsb: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the Day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
translations.kjv: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
translations.asv: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! for the day of Jehovah is near in the valley of decision.
